---
title: "Compare VirID Results between Cap and Nocap Groups"
output:
  pdf_document: default
  html_document: default
---

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(eoffice)

# Read the data
metaT_data <- fread(sprintf("%s/data/merged_nocap_Contigs_classify_res_Fast.csv", find_rstudio_root_file()), sep = ",", header = TRUE)
cap_data <- fread(sprintf("%s/data/merged_cap_Contigs_classify_res_Fast.csv", find_rstudio_root_file()), sep = ",", header = TRUE)

# Select required columns
selected_cols <- c("qlen", "Virus_Type", "Human", "Vertebrates", "Plant", "Pathogenicity_VIRUS_FAMILY")
metaT_subset <- metaT_data %>% select(all_of(selected_cols))
cap_subset <- cap_data %>% select(all_of(selected_cols))

# Add group labels
metaT_subset$group <- "MetaT"
cap_subset$group <- "HybCapSeq"

# Combine the data
combined_data <- rbind(metaT_subset, cap_subset)

# Filter out missing data
combined_data <- combined_data %>% filter(!is.na(qlen), !is.na(Pathogenicity_VIRUS_FAMILY))

# Calculate log10(qlen)
combined_data$log10_qlen <- log10(combined_data$qlen)

# Label host types
combined_data <- combined_data %>%
  mutate(Host_Type = case_when(
    Human == 1 ~ "Human",
    Vertebrates == 1 & Human == 0 ~ "Vertebrate",
    Plant == 1 ~ "Plant",
    TRUE ~ "Others"
  ))

# Specify host type order
combined_data$Host_Type <- factor(combined_data$Host_Type, levels = c("Human", "Vertebrate", "Plant", "Others"))

# Capitalize Virus_Type values
combined_data$Virus_Type <- ifelse(combined_data$Virus_Type == "known", "Known",
                                   ifelse(combined_data$Virus_Type == "noval", "Noval", combined_data$Virus_Type))

# Group log10(qlen) values into bins
bins <- c(2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5)
combined_data$log10_qlen_group <- sapply(combined_data$log10_qlen, function(x) {
  bins[which.min(abs(bins - x))]
})

# Calculate contig counts per group
summary_data <- combined_data %>%
  group_by(Pathogenicity_VIRUS_FAMILY, Virus_Type, Host_Type, group, log10_qlen_group) %>%
  summarise(Contig_Number = n(), .groups = "drop")

# CNS journal colors
cns_colors <- c("Human" = "#E41A1C", "Vertebrate" = "#E69F00", "Plant" = "#4DAF4A", "Others" = "#377EB8")

# Legend labels
legend_labels <- c("Potential human pathogens", "Associated with other vertebrates", "Associated with plants", "Associated with others")

# Bubble plot function
plot_bubble <- function(data, title, show_legend = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Pathogenicity_VIRUS_FAMILY, y = as.factor(log10_qlen_group), size = Contig_Number, color = Host_Type)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    facet_grid(Virus_Type ~ Host_Type, scales = "free", space = "free") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cns_colors, labels = legend_labels, breaks = c("Human", "Vertebrate", "Plant", "Others"), name = "Host Type") +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 10)) + 
    labs(title = title, y = "log10(nt length)", size = "Contig Number") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray90"),
      legend.position = ifelse(show_legend, "right", "none"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
  return(p)
}

# Generate plots for each group
cap_plot <- plot_bubble(summary_data %>% filter(group == "HybCapSeq"), "HybCapSeq", show_legend = FALSE)
metaT_plot <- plot_bubble(summary_data %>% filter(group == "MetaT"), "MetaT")

# Combine plots vertically
final_plot <- ggarrange(cap_plot, metaT_plot, ncol = 1, labels = c("A", "B"), common.legend = TRUE, legend = "bottom")

# Save as PDF
pdf_save_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/VirID_cap_metaT_comparison2.pdf", find_rstudio_root_file())
ggsave(pdf_save_path, plot = final_plot, width = 15, height = 10)

# Save as PPTX
pptx_save_path <- sprintf("%s/charts/VirID_cap_metaT_comparison2.pptx", find_rstudio_root_file())
topptx(final_plot, filename = pptx_save_path, height = 10, width = 15)
```
